name: 穹顶大殿

visual.preview_kind: Lodestone 0.6.0 exact NBT interior software render, not a game screenshot

changes_after_rejection.cause: 12 decorative corbel blocks were only diagonal contacts
changes_after_rejection.resolution: built continuous masonry back to the pier spine

changes_after_rejection.cause: test terrain occupied the verification volume at y=100
changes_after_rejection.resolution: moved isolated fixtures to y=240; reran in a fresh world

changes_after_rejection.cause: player collision sampler skipped the carpet lip at the stair landing
changes_after_rejection.resolution: sampled both the stair top and 1/16 carpet lift before crossing the landing

changes_after_rejection.cause: ForgeGradle remote environment certificate check stalled despite offline dependency mode
changes_after_rejection.resolution: preserved thread dump, stopped only verified H05 Gradle processes, disabled remote check for this isolated build and passed in fresh attempt4 world

deviations: Concept cutaway converted to fully enclosed three-span vaulted hall.
Blueprint scaled to 31 x 27 x 39 with six grounded piers.
Five-wide flush red-wool runner used for the level main aisle; actual carpet retained on the dais.
Teal and gold heraldry uses terracotta inlays rather than custom banner textures.
Crates and bookshelves are decorative; no inventories, loot, mobs, rewards or active FT interactions.
Vanilla default-pack lighting differs from the image concept; previews are software renders.
limitations: Isolated Forge GameTest verifies actual ServerLevel placement, native collision and survival after neighbor updates and 400 ticks; no full modpack client FPS or multiplayer run.
Safe point describes dry supported collision clearance; natural mob spawning was disabled only inside the QA fixture and production gameplay rules remain for the integrator.
Stair ascent uses native collision boxes and <=0.6-block support-height transitions; no human-controlled player client was launched.
